title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
sourceTitle: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
synopsis: A ring you didn't ask for. A road that goes ever on. Nine companions. One dark lord. You're a hobbit, mostly. You have one job.

nodes.text: Bilbo's 111th birthday. Fireworks. You are quietly happy.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Joy.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Care.

nodes.text: Gandalf comes by night. The ring tests fire. The runes appear.

choices.consequence: “Listen carefully” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: Sam at your side. Pippin and Merry crash through corn.

choices.consequence: “Take the Old Forest path” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Brave.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Direct.

nodes.text: The Prancing Pony. A stranger named Strider. Wet stones.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Trust him.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Hold off.” The story records the instinct as “Cautious” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: The Nazgûl find you. You are stabbed by a Morgul blade.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Hide the ring” back. Discipline shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Brave—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Elrond's house. Council. Voices argue. The ring sits on a plinth.

choices.consequence: “Volunteer” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Path.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.

nodes.text: Nine. Aragorn, Boromir, Gimli, Legolas, Gandalf, the four hobbits.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Open—follows you into whatever comes next.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Cautious.

nodes.text: The mountain pass. Snow. Saruman's voice in the wind.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Push through” back. Brave shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
There is no taking “Go under via Moria” back. Reluctant shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: The Doors of Durin. Speak friend and enter.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Faith.
“Argue the riddle” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Mind.

nodes.text: Dwarves long dead. A drum in the deep.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Stand by the door.” The story records the instinct as “Strategic” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Read the records.” The story records the instinct as “Honor” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: The Balrog. Gandalf, you fly fools.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Run.” The story records the instinct as “Survive” and carries it forward.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.

nodes.text: Galadriel. The mirror. The temptation.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Vow.
There is no taking “Almost take it” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Boats on the Anduin. Tall stone kings.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Wise.
You commit to “Talk with Aragorn.” The story records the instinct as “Friend” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Boromir asks for the ring. You refuse. He grabs.

choices.consequence: Save the ring.
There is no taking “Try to talk him down” back. Mercy shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: You sit by the river. Sam finds you. You decide the only way forward is alone.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Friend—follows you into whatever comes next.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Vow.

nodes.text: Sam swims after you. You pull him in. You realize you are not alone after all.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Cry.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Smile.” The story records the instinct as “Brave” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Boromir, redeemed, dies defending Merry and Pippin. Aragorn cradles him.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Honor him from afar” back. Quiet shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
There is no taking “Go back briefly” back. Heart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Aragorn vows to hunt the Uruks. You and Sam vow to take the road east.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Trust the company splits well.” The story records the instinct as “Faith” and carries it forward.
“Wish for the company whole” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: Stones, mist, no path. Gollum follows.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Set a trap” back. Cunning shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Direct—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: He bargains. He swears on the precious.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Trust slowly.” The story records the instinct as “Path” and carries it forward.
“Don't trust” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.

nodes.text: The Black Gate. Closed. The land smokes. The road, somehow, continues.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Find the secret way” back. Path shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
“Wait” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Patience.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: The road goes on for two more books. You and Sam, at the end, throw it into the fire. The Shire heals. You sail west, eventually, with Bilbo.
Sam is, in the end, the hero of the story. He marries Rosie. He has many children. You write a book about it. The book becomes, in time, scripture.
You return changed. Most don't notice. Sam notices. The Gaffer notices. You sit by the river and write, in a small careful hand, the whole tale.
